question: What were the net earnings (in millions) for Goldman Sachs for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021 (as reported in its 2022 Form 10-K) and for fiscal year ended December 31, 2023 (as reported in its 2024 Form 10-K), and how did these figures compare to Bank of America's net earnings for the same fiscal years as reported in its 2022 and 2024 Form 10-Ks? Provide the absolute difference in net earnings between the two companies for each year.
answer: Goldman Sachs net earnings for fiscal year 2021: $21,635 million (GS 2022 Form 10-K, Item 7, Financial Overview). Bank of America net earnings for fiscal year 2021: $31,978 million (BAC 2022 Form 10-K, Item 7, MD&A). Difference: $10,343 million. Goldman Sachs net earnings for fiscal year 2023: $8,515 million (GS 2024 Form 10-K, Item 7, Financial Overview). Bank of America net earnings for fiscal year 2023: $26,516 million (BAC 2024 Form 10-K, Item 7, MD&A). Difference: $18,001 million.

question: What were the net earnings (loss) applicable to common shareholders for Goldman Sachs in 2022 and 2024, and for Bank of America in the same years, and which company showed a greater percentage decline from 2022 to 2024?
answer: Goldman Sachs: 2022 net earnings applicable to common shareholders were $12,395 million; 2024 were $8,452 million. Bank of America: 2022 net earnings applicable to common shareholders were $27,528 million; 2024 were $25,131 million. The percentage decline for Goldman Sachs was (8,452 - 12,395) / 12,395 = -31.8%. For Bank of America, (25,131 - 27,528) / 27,528 = -8.7%. Goldman Sachs had the greater percentage decline.
evidence_section: GS 2022: Item 7 'Management's Discussion and Analysis' – Financial Overview table; GS 2024: Item 7 'Management's Discussion and Analysis' – Financial Overview table; BAC 2022: Item 7 'Management's Discussion and Analysis' – Selected Financial Data; BAC 2024: Item 7 'Management's Discussion and Analysis' – Selected Financial Data

question: What was the percentage change in net earnings from fiscal year 2021 to fiscal year 2023 for Goldman Sachs and Bank of America, and which company experienced a larger decline?
answer: Goldman Sachs net earnings decreased from $21,635 million in fiscal year 2021 to $8,515 million in fiscal year 2023, a decline of approximately 60.6%. Bank of America net earnings decreased from $31,978 million in fiscal year 2021 to $26,517 million in fiscal year 2023, a decline of approximately 17.1%. Goldman Sachs experienced a larger decline.
